name: Clip-On Open-Ear Earbuds — Dome
description: Open-ear earbuds that clip onto the ear instead of sitting inside it, in a rounded dome-shaped charging case. Bluetooth 6.0, a charging cable in the box, and they work with iPhone and Android.

source.notes: Seller style B73 2026 (milk-tea = Cream, obsidian = Black, taro = Purple). Price not seen: B73 is not visible in the colour screenshots.
